text:
sara_sales: Heads-up - prospect Nimbus signed LOI contingent on a runway plan. They expect short bursts up to ~5k QPS (chat heavy) during promotions. Need reserved floor + autoscale + billing delta for SOW.

tonY_eng: s/tony_eng: Quick details please: chat/embed split, avg tokens, burst duration?

sara_sales: 80% chat, 20% embed. Avg chat ~200 tokens. Bursts last ~45-90s every 8-12 minutes during campaign windows.

tonY_eng: Back-of-envelope: 5k*0.8=4k chat qps *200=800k tokens/sec. Our quantized baseline ~60k tok/s per GPU => ~14 GPUs needed at peak. Embeds add concurrency but small token cost.

vik_ops: Recommend reserved_floor=12, autoscale to 28 with burst_pool. But to hit p95<400ms we should either increase floor->16 or enforce strict preheat + KV caching.

claire_pm: Customer asks for 99.9% uptime and p95 SLA. We need failure-mode language for SOW (spot eviction, AZ outage, fallback quality).

deploy-bot: scheduled preheat created job=preheat-nimbus-1746001111 targets=kv-warm,model-cache,probe-rps

sara_sales: Tony, can you give a cost delta for floor=12 vs 16 and a short autoscale snippet for the SOW?

tonY_eng: Autoscale draft:
```
min_replicas: 12
max_replicas: 28
scale_metric: "tokens_per_second"
target_util_pct: 65
cooldown_secs: 90
preheat_window_secs: 300
burst_pool: true
```
Cost note: floor=12 => lower reserved cost but ~+35-45% burst autoscale usage. floor=16 => higher reserved baseline, ~15-25% less autoscale burn. I'll add dollar estimates in a spreadsheet.

vik_ops: Ops checklist: AZ spread, placement groups, preheat verification, fallback smaller model validated, synthetic smoke test. I'll draft runbook.

claire_pm: Also include legal failure modes: if AZ failure -> failover to another region with degraded quality; if spot eviction -> route to reserved pool and/or lower-quality quantized model. Provide RTO and expected quality delta.

sara_sales: Great. Action items: Tony -> spreadsheet + refined autoscale config; Vik -> runbook + preheat proof; Claire -> legal failure-mode text. I'll loop in AE for SOW sign-off.

vik_ops: Ack, creating runbook now and will ping when ready.

tonY_eng: I'll post numbers by EOD.

sara_sales: Thanks everyone, keeping this concise for exec review.
